programme.desc: 'S33/E2 - Takeout: Bringing Comfort Home'. Guy Fieri cooks grilled cheese from Nashville, pizza from Boulder, CO, Memphis fried chicken and Greek kebabs out of Houston, TX, all via video chat!

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S6/E17 - Fishing For Fire'. Roger shows off three flame-inspired feasts that pack serious heat. Including a 200-lb salmon that is roasted over the biggest fire Roger's ever used.

programme.title: Man Fire Food
programme.desc: 'S6/E18 - Women Fire Food'. Roger meets some of America's most impressive and creative female pit masters. Along the way, he picks up new useful skills and incredible recipes.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: 'S20/E27 - Trick Or Treat'. The owner of the Dutch Treat in Franconia, NH, has lost the will to keep his family restaurant going. His wife wants to help, but the outlet needs a strong manager.

programme.title: Buddy Vs. Duff
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - Animal Kingdom'. Buddy Valastro and Duff Goldman try to out-do each other with African safari-inspired cakes. A panel of 50 talented cake artists vote on the winner.

programme.title: Buddy Vs. Duff

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E16 - Trinidad And Tobago'. Andrew samples the culinary mashups of Trinidad and Tobago including curried crab with dumplings, crispy fried shark sandwiches, and soft flatbreads.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
programme.desc: 'S6/E17 - Mississippi Delta'. Andrew explores the iconic soul food of the Mississippi Delta. Fried catfish, hushpuppies, smothered oxtails and mud pie all have a definite soul soothing power.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E12 - Breakfast For Dessert'. Four chefs attempt to make breakfast-themed desserts. The baskets include a coffee drink, a cleverly designed candy and waffle dough.

programme.desc: 'S31/E12 - GGG Call-Outs'. Guy hosts grudge matches! First, a chef calls out the opponent who bested her in a bacon brawl, then Damaris Phillips settles the score with a vegetarian rematch.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S24/E5 - High Roller Steakhouse Dinner'. The chefs cook decadent dishes inspired by Las Vegas. Their delicious menu includes lemony baked Alaska, Caesar salad and shrimp with garlic.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S42/E4 - Soup, Salad and Sorbet Spins'. Guy Fieri's sampling carnitas ramen in Austin, TX, prime-time pulled pork poutine in Cincinnati, and sorbet with a tom-yum twist in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S48/E9 - Battle Of The Meats: Bison'. This fierce battle features a lean protein: bison! The first round sees the chefs going in distinct directions with their jellybean and rib appetisers.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S2/E8 - Meet Your Mash'. Host Alex Guarnaschelli sets up a desert stakeout in Arizona. The competing chefs make it Mediterranean before mashing up classics, parking lot-style.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S27/E6 - DDD Summer Games Finale'. For the finale, Guy sends the finalists on a virtual summer road trip! The chefs must pick up state-inspired food items to feature in an upscale diner dish.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S20/E15 - Going Green'. The team honour Earth Day with fresh finds that celebrate spring flavours. They make seafood stew with cilantro broth, Italian-stuffed artichokes and more!

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E13 - Neapolitan Delight'. Four chefs go to battle with three classic flavours - strawberry, vanilla and chocolate. In the first round, the chefs must attempt a tricky Chinese delicacy.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S6/E10 - No Utensils Needed'. Four chefs need all hands-on deck to deliver a dish that needs two hands to take down. Then, they hit the fryers to create fried finger food.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S6/E11 - The Big Dip'. The chefs make deli-worthy dishes before completing a grand gesture. The final stakeout comes down to a difficult decision between two dipped dishes.

programme.title: Supermarket Stakeout
programme.desc: 'S6/E12 - All-American Parking Lot'. The chefs compete to make home-run ballpark dishes and something Southern. The final two competitors prepare cookies for the win.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S49/E9 - Martha Rules: Pantry Surprise!'. Martha Stewart puts four fearless chefs to the test as they vie for a $50,000 prize. First, she asks them to create a dish with blueberry pie and oysters.
